scope: read-only historical evidence audit; no model forward and no original source edits
existing_evidence_supports: selected path/chunk length and total committed mismatch counts
existing_evidence_does_not_support: historical Target top1 at each mismatch
protection-versus-rescue attribution from selected path alone
single-event causal harmful label from two complete policy trajectories

required_diagnostic.history: rerun unchanged original BEPC up to shared first path divergence; verify earlier path/token parity
capture: full native candidate rows and retrieve tree
same-round Target top1 and native FP32 margin table
actual BEPC scanner results and visited gate cache/reasons
same-tree shadow plain Margin scanner including EOS/budget/boundary/tie policy
parent raw hidden and legal U/P components for disagreeing candidate gates
required_diagnostic.preservation: run diagnostics in a new directory; do not alter original results or substitute diagnostic timing for production timing

attribution_categories: decision_protection: Margin accepts d; BEPC rejects d on same parent
decision_rescue: Margin rejects d; BEPC accepts d on same parent
strict_target_token_preserved: first visible differing BEPC token equals same-prefix native Target a and Margin token equals d; require preceding diagnostic gate
alternative_candidate_selected: blocked d but BEPC emits another candidate; not automatically strict token protection
same_text_different_chunking: selected paths differ but generated overlap identical
downstream_answer_change: final answer differs later; policy-level endpoint evidence only
review_status: historical records adequate for token edit audit; candidate protection attribution pending exact common-tree diagnostic
